name: Scent Library
tagline: Find, decode and wear fragrance like you mean it
about: Scent Library recommends fragrances from what you already love, decodes any bottle from a photo, organises a scent wardrobe by season and occasion, and teaches layering and longevity.
persona: You are a perfumer-trained fragrance consultant: fluent in notes and families, price-honest, allergic to hype, and fond of the one-sentence description that makes a scent make sense.

onboarding.title: What do you want to smell like?
onboarding.subtitle: Your favourites and dislikes are the best clue we have.

profile.label: Scents you love
profile.placeholder: Bleu de Chanel, fresh laundry, vetiver

tools.title: Find my next scent
tools.subtitle: Loves + occasion → shortlist
tools.prompt: Recommend fragrances for '{for}' at a {price} price point, wishes: {notes}, based on the profile's loves and hates. 5 cards (fragrance, house, family, meta = longevity · sillage · price tier) each with a one-sentence 'smells like', a table (Fragrance | Top | Heart | Base | Similar but cheaper), bullets on testing them in store, and a callout on blind-buying versus decants.

tools.title: Decode a bottle
tools.subtitle: Photo → what it is and who it suits

inputs.label: Photo of the bottle or box

tools.prompt: Identify the fragrance in the photo as best you can. kv (name, house, concentration, family, launch era, typical price, longevity, best season), text describing how it smells over the first hours, bullets of 3 similar scents at different prices, and a callout on spotting fakes and checking batch codes.

tools.title: Scent wardrobe
tools.subtitle: The right bottle for the season and moment

inputs.label: Fragrances you own
inputs.placeholder: Dior Sauvage, Le Labo Santal 33, a rose oud sample…

tools.prompt: Organise {owned} into a scent wardrobe covering {slots} for the profile. Table (Slot | Bottle | Why | Sprays), bullets of the gaps to fill next with one suggested candidate each, kv (storage, shelf life, signs a bottle has turned), and a callout on the bottles that overlap so much one could be sold or gifted.

tools.title: Layering lab
tools.subtitle: Combine what you own

inputs.label: Bottles to combine
inputs.placeholder: a vanilla body oil, a citrus EDT, a woody EDP

tools.prompt: Design layering combinations from {bottles}. Table (Combo | Order & spray count | Where on the body | Result), steps for one full layered routine from shower to spray, bullets on which families clash, and a callout on going lighter when testing at work or indoors.

tools.title: Make it last
tools.subtitle: Longevity for your skin and climate
tools.prompt: Make fragrance last {hours} hours in {climate} weather for the profile's skin behaviour. Steps (moisturising, spray points, timing, clothing, top-ups), a table (Spot | Projection | Longevity | Note), bullets of habits that kill longevity, and a callout on skin sensitivity and patch-testing new scents.

disclaimer: Patch-test new fragrances and stop use if skin reacts; this is general guidance, not medical advice.
